messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drafted the graph: the user, the web app, the users database and the email service. The email service is outside your app's backend, and the users database sits inside it beside the web app. The flow runs from the user to the app, then to the database to find the account, then out to the email service, back to the user by email, and finally back to the app when they set a new password.

I assumed the reset link opens in the same web app, and that the user is signed in straight after choosing the password. Is the graph right? If so, I'll agree the story with you next.
The graph looks good. I approve it.
